info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Capital Markets Trading Insights API
info.description: The Capital Markets Trading Insights API provides businesses with access to critical information regarding wholesale trading activities in capital markets. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed insights based on specific parameters, facilitating informed decision-making in trading operations. Financial analysts and trading departments can leverage this data to optimize strategies and enhance performance in capital markets. By utilizing this API, organizations can stay competitive and responsive to market changes.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about the specified capital market resource identified by RES-100045, enabling users to access relevant trading data and insights.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information for retrieving wholesale trading data from the capital markets. The data specified within the body will influence the results returned by the operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the response contains the requested data.
